tasks.subject: Task 1: Add "Areas We Serve" sections to service hub pages
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a linked location grid to each of the 7 service hub pages so Google can discover the 50+ orphaned service+location combination pages.

**Files:**
- Modify: stormwater-design.html
- Modify: geotechnical-engineering.html
- Modify: structural-engineering.html
- Modify: wastewater-design.html
- Modify: civil-engineering.html
- Modify: geotechnical-report.html
- Modify: soil-testing.html

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Each service hub page contains a section with id="areas-we-serve"
- [ ] Every location variant linked with anchor text "[Service] in [Location]"
- [ ] CSS .service-area-links present in each page style block

**Verify:** powershell Select-String for 'areas-we-serve' in each file — expect 1 match each

```json:metadata
{"files":["stormwater-design.html","geotechnical-engineering.html","structural-engineering.html","wastewater-design.html","civil-engineering.html","geotechnical-report.html","soil-testing.html"],"verifyCommand":"Select-String areas-we-serve","acceptanceCriteria":["7 service hub pages contain id=areas-we-serve section","All location variant links present","CSS .service-area-links added"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Update sitemap.xml lastmod dates
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update lastmod to 2026-05-22 for all 21 modified pages in sitemap.xml.

**Files:** sitemap.xml

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All 21 modified pages in sitemap
- [ ] Their lastmod = 2026-05-22
- [ ] No pages removed

**Verify:** (Select-String -Path sitemap.xml -Pattern '2026-05-22').Count ≥ 21

```json:metadata
{"files":["sitemap.xml"],"verifyCommand":"(Select-String -Path sitemap.xml -Pattern '2026-05-22').Count","acceptanceCriteria":["21+ pages have lastmod 2026-05-22","No pages removed from sitemap"]}
```
